sn47.46:1.1: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || la || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || || 3.
sn47.46:2.1: Sādhu me bhante saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu yam aham Bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto vihareyyanti ||
sn47.46:2.2: Tasmā ti ha tvam bhikkhu ādim eva visodhehi kusalesu dhammesu || ||
sn47.46:2.4: Idha tvam bhikkhu pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharāhi ācāragocarasampanno anumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī samādāya sikkhasu sikkhāpadesu || ||
sn47.46:2.5: Yato kho tvam bhikkhu pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharissasi ācāragocarasampanno anumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī samādāya sikkhissasi sikkhāpadesu || tato tvam bhikkhu sīlaṃ nissāya sīle patiṭṭhāya cattāro satipaṭṭhāne bhāveyyāsi ||
sn47.46:3.2: Idha tvam bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharāhi ||
sn47.46:3.5: Dhammesu dhammānupassī viharāhi ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || || 6.
sn47.46:3.6: Yato kho tvam bhikkhu sīlaṃ nissāya sīle patiṭṭhāya ime cattāro satipaṭṭhāne evam bhāvessasi || tato tuyham bhikkhu yā ratti vā divāso vā āgamissati vuddhi yeva pāṭikaṅkhā kusalesu dhammesu no parihānīti || || 7.
sn47.46:3.7: Atha kho so bhikkhu Bhagavato bhāsitaṃ- || || 8.
sn47.46:4.1: Atha kho so bhikkhu eko vūpakattho-
sn47.46:4.3: Aññataro capana so bhikkhu arahatam ahosī
